kasa.intro: Development of a responsive real estate rental application using React, with dynamic property pages and reusable UI components.
kasa.about: Kasa is a real estate rental platform developed from design mockups. I built the front-end using React, Vite and SCSS, creating a responsive interface with reusable components. The application displays property listings from JSON data and allows users to explore detailed accommodation pages through dynamic routes.
kasa.challenge: Transform static design mockups into a functional, responsive React application while maintaining a consistent user experience across desktop, tablet and mobile devices. The project also required implementing dynamic navigation, interactive components and appropriate error handling for invalid routes or nonexistent properties.
kasa.solution: Built a component-based architecture using React, with React Router for navigation and SCSS for responsive styling. Implemented reusable banners, collapsible sections and an image carousel with navigation controls. Property information is dynamically retrieved from JSON data, and a dedicated 404 page handles unknown routes and invalid property IDs.

grimoire.intro: Development of a secure REST API for a community-driven book catalog and rating platform.
grimoire.about: Mon Vieux Grimoire is an application that allows users to browse, publish and rate books. I developed the entire back-end using Node.js, Express and MongoDB, handling data management, user authentication and image processing.
grimoire.challenge: Design a reliable and secure API supporting user authentication, book management and ratings, while protecting user data and optimizing image storage.
grimoire.solution: Built a REST API using Express and MongoDB, with JWT authentication, bcrypt password hashing and authorization checks. Images are processed with Multer and Sharp and converted to WebP. A rating system automatically calculates average book scores.

sophie.intro: Development of dynamic features and an authenticated administration interface for an interior architect's portfolio using JavaScript.
sophie.about: Sophie Bluel is an interior architect's portfolio website. My role was to make the existing interface interactive using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. I connected the gallery to a REST API to dynamically display projects and categories, and implemented an administration interface allowing the architect to manage her work.
sophie.challenge: Turn a static portfolio into a dynamic application connected to an API, allowing visitors to filter projects by category while providing authenticated users with tools to manage the gallery. The main challenges involved handling asynchronous requests, managing authentication states and implementing a smooth administration experience without relying on a front-end framework.
sophie.solution: Used the Fetch API to retrieve and display projects dynamically, with category-based filtering. Implemented a login form with token-based authentication, an editing mode and modal interfaces for adding and deleting projects. New projects are submitted using FormData to send images and associated information to the API, while the gallery updates dynamically after modifications.

nina.intro: Performance, SEO and accessibility optimization of a professional photographer's portfolio website.
nina.about: Nina Carducci is a photography portfolio website. My role was to analyze its performance and technical structure, then improve loading speed, accessibility and search engine visibility while preserving the original visual identity and functionality.
nina.challenge: Identify and resolve performance, accessibility and SEO issues in an existing website without compromising its design or user experience. Key priorities included reducing image sizes and improving HTML structure to support navigation and search engine indexing.
nina.solution: Converted and optimized images to WebP, improved semantic HTML, alternative text and SEO metadata. Lighthouse audits measured the improvements: performance increased from 56 to 94, accessibility from 68 to 100, and SEO from 73 to 100.
